content:
I've updated the main zulip linkifiers to point to mathlib4 rather than mathlib.

Thus:

  • #4593
  • file#Logic/Equiv/Embedding
  • docs#SimpleGraph
  • src#pickle
  • #queue

you can still link to (Lean 3) mathlib resources using:

  • !3#19208
  • file3#logic/equiv/array
  • docs3#simple_graph
  • src3#finset.smul_sum
  • #queue3

Note that this does not change the behaviour of links in previously sent messages on zulip, just new posts or edited posts.

All of the above are still available in Lean 4 specific versions, as well. There are a number of linkifiers that still need updating, but that point to the Lean 3 tactic documentation and don't have good replacements at this point.
